title: Smoked Salmon Pasta Bake
description: A rich and creamy pasta bake infused with the flavors of Italian cuisine and the smokiness of salmon.
instructions: Cook penne pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add cream and stir to combine.
Add cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss to coat.
In a separate bowl, mix together smoked salmon, mozzarella cheese, and Italian seasoning.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of pasta followed by a layer of salmon mixture.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of pasta on top.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs and chopped parsley on top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
